title: SkillInode
description: Content-addressed Skill identity (M40). The hash covers SKILL.md + capability.yaml, so a Skill edit yields a new inode; reputation carry-over to a new inode requires explicit Captain approval.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 hex over the Skill's hashed source files.

sources.description: Skill-relative files covered by the content hash.

lifecycle_stage.description: Stage read from capability.yaml content (descriptive, not prescriptive).

carry_over_from.description: Predecessor skill inode ID when content changed.

captain_approved.description: True only when the Captain approved reputation carry-over to this inode. Experience-pinned reputation never transfers silently.
